Our approach

We organise financial information into useful reporting for management. Accounting and outsourcing support can be combined with process reviews, analytics and financial oversight according to the scope of the engagement.

How is the scope of an engagement determined?

Services are agreed based on your requirements, applicable professional standards and the circumstances of the matter. Contact the firm to discuss the relevant scope and documentation.

Can related practice areas be combined?

Yes. Depending on the engagement, our partners can coordinate accounting, tax, assurance and advisory expertise, subject to applicable independence and professional requirements.

Common questions.

Does PSB Associates provide outsourced accounting and virtual CFO services?

P S B & Associates LLP provides bookkeeping, ledger scrutiny, payroll support, MIS reporting and virtual CFO services.

What does the accounting and virtual CFO practice cover?

The practice combines accounting records, management reporting, financial planning and process reviews according to the agreed scope. It also includes MIS design, data analytics and business process outsourcing support.

How is an accounting engagement scoped?

Share your business activity, current accounting system, reporting needs and the support required. The firm agrees the deliverables, responsibilities and scope based on your circumstances.
